: Glanbia’s nine-month FY26 like-for-like revenue rose 9.9%, with volume up 4.2%. It lifted adjusted EPS growth guidance to 22%–24% and Performance Nutrition revenue growth to 16%–17%.
: • Glanbia Plc (GL9) appointed Wendy Chang Smith as CFO designate. She is due to become CFO and an executive director on March 31, 2027.
